name: The Honking Deep (eldritch goose boss)
scale_note: Boss scale against the 1.80 m reference human: about 6.5 m to the twig tips of the main head's dead maple crown (crown of the head about 4.95 m), 8.5 m across from finger-claw to finger-claw. Faces -Y, +Z up, origin on the ground between the feet. All design numbers below are metres in that frame.
budget_note: Hero asset: about 30x the scythe prop's budget. Every tooth, rib and feather is real geometry, not a texture.

build: Body: lofted ellipse rings, about 3.7 m long, 1.88 m wide, lowest point 1.06 m; soot-brown back, ashen bars on the flanks, grimy breast (straight seam at y = -0.42 m), dirty-bone belly and undertail; five bare ribs break through each flank.

Necks: one main S-neck from the breast to 4.7 m, radius 0.36 m tapering to 0.165 m; two side necks out to +/-1.36 m, radius 0.26 to 0.13 m. All black, a ridge of 13 bone spines down the back of the main neck.

Heads: goose heads crowned with dead bare maple branches (two gnarled limbs 0.85 m long, spread sideways like antlers and forking three times, a few rotting leaves still hanging), the white chinstrap, one small sunken dark eye a side, beaks gaping (42 deg main, 58 deg side) with rows of teeth on both mandibles and a spiked tongue. Side heads at 0.74 scale.

Wings: raised and spread, 8.5 m across including the bare finger bones, arm 0.17 m to 0.04 m thick; 10 badly ragged primaries 1.45 to 1.05 m, 12 secondaries, 5 tertials, two covert rows; two finger bones 1.25 m long with claws break out past the primaries.
Legs: black, hip 1.55 m to ankle; three webbed toes 0.48 m long spread 32 deg, bone claws, a small back toe.
Tail: nine ragged black feathers 0.9 m long in a cupped fan over 80 deg, outer feathers banked and drooping so the fan reads from the side.
Spines: a bone ridge along the back and down the main neck.

Dead maple: 16 rotting maple leaves 0.42 to 0.62 m matted into the back, 4 on the main neck, 4 on each wing arm; a maple leaf about 0.85 m across branded into the centre of the breast as a raised dark scar bent to its curve; below it three rows of ragged breast feathers (9, 10, 11) 0.85 to 1.10 m long hanging down, soaked in dried blood from the tips up.
style: Canadian Bloodborne-style beast horror: a goose gone feral in a dead maple wood. Soot, ash, grimy bone, dried blood and rotting maple red; starved and ragged; no emissive materials.
